resources.string: These are the changes you asked Ask Taizo to make to what PixlAudio recommends. They sit on top of what the app learns from your plays. Nothing is deleted, and you can take any of them back.
Ask Taizo to play more or less of an artist, genre or song, or to keep something out of your mixes, and it will show up here.
Recommendations go back to what the app learned from your plays alone. Your songs and history are not touched.
Muted: kept out of mixes and shelves
